Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: draft attached

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for stepping in. Attached are our internal draft MSA (Foundry_MSA_v1.0.docx) and the initial order form spreadsheet (OrderForm_Foundry_proposal.xlsx). We'd like to get a fast kickoff so we can align on scope and get your legal team a first pass of redlines. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether Redwood prefers using your standard MSA template or whether you’ll accept Foundry’s as the baseline (we can flip if easier).
- Data residency: some workloads must remain in EU; please confirm whether Redwood can commit to region scoping in the Order Form / Exhibit.
- SOC 2 + subprocessor list: please share what evidence you can provide early (SOC 2 report, subprocessors spreadsheet).
- Signer + billing contact: who will execute and who receives PO/invoice?
- Timeline: we'd like an initial annotated redline within 5 business days of kickoff where possible.

We’re available for a 30–45m kickoff this week or early next. Proposed times below.

Attachments: Foundry_MSA_v1.0.docx, OrderForm_Foundry_proposal.xlsx

Thanks —
Amira Johnson
Head of Business Operations
Foundry Therapeutics

Amira —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. I’ve reviewed the attachments quickly — appreciate the summary. Redwood’s normal flow is to start from our standard MSA unless the counterparty requests otherwise; happy to operate either way if you have specific clauses you need preserved.

Quick responses / next steps:

1) Kickoff call: can you do Tue 2026-09-22 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45m)? If not, propose a couple alternatives.
2) Technical contacts & billing: please confirm primary technical contact and billing contact (we’ll loop them into the kickoff).
3) Volume & sequence profile: please share expected monthly token volumes and average/peak sequence lengths — that helps us propose appropriate instance sizing and billing cadence.
4) Residency & compliance: we’ll plan to bring Kimberly (counsel) and David (privacy/compliance) on the call to triage residency and SOC2 evidence requests.
5) Timeline: Kimberly will produce an annotated redline and an initial comment log within 3 business days after the kickoff call.

I’ll drop a calendar invite once you confirm the time.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive

Jonas —

Tue 9/22 10:00 AM PT works for us. Confirmed participants: Brian Lee (technical lead) and Linda Parker (billing / AP). Our legal lead who will sign is Marcus Holt (marcus.holt@foundrytx.com) — he’ll join if available; if not, Marcus will sign offline.

Volume guidance (initial):
- Expected month 1: 10M tokens (mix of short prompts and multi-turn generation)
- Expected steady-state: 35–50M tokens / month within 3 months
- Typical max sequence lengths: 2048 tokens for long runs; typical 256–512 tokens for interactive use

Residency note: certain patient-related PII must be stored/processed in the EU region for regulatory reasons. We need to understand how Redwood maps Order Form exhibits to region scoping and whether that will be reflected in the deployment SLA.

I’ve attached a cleaned version of the Order Form with a couple of clarifying rows (Foundry_OrderForm_v1.1.xlsx).

Thanks — looking forward to Tuesday.

—Amira
From: kimberly_park <kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amira Johnson <amira@foundrytx.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, david_kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff: draft attached

Amira / team —

Appreciate the details and the order form update. Quick note from legal ahead of the kickoff so we can triage efficiently on the call:

Primary initial redline topics we’ll target in the annotated pass:

1) Liability & cap: propose annual cap aligned to fees (we’ll outline proposed language / numbers in the annotated doc).
2) Data residency / Exhibit B: will request explicit exhibit language tying workload IDs in the Order Form to region scoping and data residency obligations; we’ll need to confirm whether encryption key ownership or KMS options are required.
3) Subprocessor / SOC2 evidence: request the current SOC 2 Type II report and an up-to-date subprocessor list; we’ll propose a 30-day notification window for changes to subprocessors.
4) Training & IP carveouts: we typically carve out obligation to indemnify for downstream use of customer-provided prompts / data — will propose limited carveouts and language around model training.
5) Termination for convenience / transition assistance: ask for 30–60 days transition assistance commitments and export of customer data in a machine-readable format.

Action plan: I’ll prepare an annotated PDF (Foundry_MSA_v1.0-annotated.pdf) and a short comment log by end-of-day 2026-09-22 (business day following kickoff). Please confirm the SOC 2 contact and where we can retrieve subprocessors.

See you on Tue.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
kim@redwoodinference.com
